title: missing
summary: Create missing string scalars or arrays.

gpu_support.notes: The documented zero-argument form runs on the host. Size arguments belong to a gated RunMat extension and are rejected before provider access in MATLAB-compatible mode.

description: `missing` creates a scalar containing RunMat's canonical MATLAB missing string sentinel, `<missing>`. The documented MATLAB function accepts no input arguments.
behaviors: `missing(n)`, `missing(m,n,...)`, and `missing(sz)` are gated RunMat conveniences rather than documented MATLAB forms.
RunMat extension size controls accept all eight integer classes and are checked exactly against nonnegative host allocation limits.
MATLAB-compatible mode rejects any supplied argument before gathering or provider lookup.
The result uses `StringArray` storage and displays each element as `<missing>`.
